landmarks.name: grey sofa
landmarks.description: Large grey fabric sofa with throw pillows and a yellow blanket on the far arm.

landmarks.name: dark armchair with wood arms
landmarks.description: Dark upholstered armchair with curved wooden armrests.

landmarks.name: TV on white stand
landmarks.description: Flat-screen TV sitting on a low white media console with glass-front doors.

landmarks.name: triple glass doors
landmarks.description: Three tall glass panels in white frames leading to an exterior concrete area.

landmarks.name: floor lamp
landmarks.description: Tripod floor lamp with a round white drum shade in the corner near the grey sofa.

landmarks.name: black and white abstract painting
landmarks.description: Large horizontal black, white, and grey abstract canvas above the grey sofa.

landmarks.name: dining table with blue chairs
landmarks.description: Round table surrounded by light blue upholstered chairs on the wood floor.

landmarks.name: white square pillar
landmarks.description: Floor-to-ceiling white structural column with a small potted plant at its base.

landmarks.name: bed with grey headboard
landmarks.description: Large bed with a tufted grey headboard, white linens, and a patterned throw.

landmarks.name: recessed double window
landmarks.description: Deep-set two-pane window with a wide white sill near the bed with the grey headboard.

landmarks.name: grey curved chair
landmarks.description: Low accent chair with a curved grey backrest and wooden legs near the recessed double window.

landmarks.name: open closet with shelves
landmarks.description: Reach-in closet with open white doors and built-in white wire/wood shelving near the bed with the grey headboard.

landmarks.name: potted plant in basket by bed doorway
landmarks.description: Leafy green plant in a woven basket sitting in the corner next to the doorway by the bed with the grey headboard.

landmarks.name: white vanity and toilet
landmarks.description: White two-door sink cabinet next to a white toilet on light-colored floor tiles.

landmarks.name: small black-framed picture
landmarks.description: Small square black-and-white print in a black frame with a white mat on the wall between doorways.

landmarks.name: empty white corner
landmarks.description: Bare white walls meeting at a corner with light wood flooring past the small black-framed picture.

landmarks.name: white horizontal-panel door
landmarks.description: Interior white door with horizontal grooves near the empty white corner and the bed with the wooden headboard.

landmarks.name: dark counter with stools
landmarks.description: Dark wood island counter with metal barstools tucked underneath between the wood floor and tile floor.

landmarks.name: grey flat door with red top
landmarks.description: Flush grey door with a red bar along the top edge and red tape on the left lever handle.

landmarks.name: white double closet doors
landmarks.description: Pair of white doors with horizontal grooves and silver lever handles meeting in the center alongside the tiled floor.

landmarks.name: potted plant in basket near double doors
landmarks.description: Green plant in a basket on the floor near the white double closet doors and dining table.

landmarks.name: tall dried branches in vase
landmarks.description: Tall bundle of brown dried branches in a dark floor vase against a short wall column near the grey flat door.

landmarks.name: stainless stove and microwave
landmarks.description: Stainless steel range with blue protective film on the lower drawer and a mounted microwave above, flanked by dark grey lower cabinets and white upper cabinets.

landmarks.name: stainless refrigerator
landmarks.description: Tall stainless steel refrigerator next to dark brown cabinets on the light tiled floor.

landmarks.name: wooden desk with chair
landmarks.description: Long light-wood desk against a white wall with a grey moulded chair.

landmarks.name: skyline print
landmarks.description: Horizontal black-and-white city skyline print on the wall between the wooden desk and small grey loveseat.

landmarks.name: small grey loveseat
landmarks.description: Two-cushion grey fabric loveseat with patterned pillows, a framed map above it, and a wooden stump side table to its right.

landmarks.name: black and white curved-lines painting
landmarks.description: Horizontal canvas with bold black curved brushstrokes on a white background, hanging on the wall near the dark counter.

landmarks.name: woven basket by TV stand
landmarks.description: Round woven basket with a lid on the wood floor next to the white TV stand.

landmarks.name: bed with wooden headboard
landmarks.description: Large bed with a slatted wooden headboard, white bedding, and a wooden nightstand on the right.

landmarks.name: hanging woven tapestry
landmarks.description: Vertical cream and black woven wall hanging with fringe at the bottom near the bed with the wooden headboard.

landmarks.name: black round chair by window
landmarks.description: Round black woven papasan-style chair with a white pillow in the corner under a square window.

landmarks.name: walk-through shelving unit
landmarks.description: Built-in white open shelves and hanging rods along the right wall of a narrow passage.

landmarks.name: white toilet with wall art
landmarks.description: White toilet on light tile floor with a small purple-toned canvas hanging above it at the end of the shelving passage.

landmarks.name: white washer and dryer
landmarks.description: Side-by-side white laundry machines against the left wall on a light tiled floor beyond the stainless refrigerator.

landmarks.name: open ceiling hatch
landmarks.description: Square opening in the white ceiling exposing pipes and ductwork above the white washer and dryer.

connections.how: Walk forward with the grey sofa on your left and the dark armchair with wood arms and TV on white stand on your right.
Turn around to face away from the triple glass doors and walk across the wood floor with the TV on white stand on your left and the grey sofa on your right.
Pass the white square pillar on your left and turn right through the doorway.
Walk forward past the foot of the bed with grey headboard on your left and the grey curved chair on your right.
Turn around to the left, walk back past the bed with grey headboard on your right, and turn right into the open closet with shelves before the doorway.

Step out of the open closet with shelves, turn left through the doorway past the potted plant in basket by bed doorway, pass the white square pillar, turn right, and then turn left to face the tiled doorway.
Instead of stepping onto the tile toward the white vanity and toilet, turn left past the small black-framed picture on your right into the bare corner.
Turn around, walk past the white horizontal-panel door and the small black-framed picture on your left, and turn right past the dining table with blue chairs on your left.

connections.to: grey flat door with red top
connections.how: Walk forward onto the light tile floor with the dark counter with stools on your left and the white double closet doors on your right.

connections.from: grey flat door with red top
connections.how: From the tile floor in front of the grey flat door with red top and tall dried branches in vase, turn left to face the appliances opposite the dark counter with stools.

connections.from: grey flat door with red top
connections.how: Walk forward past the tall dried branches in vase and the grey flat door with red top on your left and the white double closet doors on your right to enter the doorway ahead, where the wooden desk with chair is on the left, skyline print is ahead, and small grey loveseat is on the right.
Turn right to exit the doorway past the grey flat door with red top and tall dried branches in vase on your right, stepping onto the white tile facing the dark counter with stools.

Walk forward from the tiled area keeping the dark counter with stools and dining table with blue chairs on your left and the black and white curved-lines painting on your right, then angle right toward the doorway next to the TV on white stand.
Pass the woven basket by TV stand and white horizontal-panel door and step through the doorway ahead.
Upon entering by the bed with wooden headboard, turn right and walk down the narrow passage with the walk-through shelving unit on your right toward the open door ahead.
Backtrack from the doorway of the white toilet with wall art along the walk-through shelving unit into the area with the bed with wooden headboard and black round chair by window.

Turn to face the doorway by the hanging woven tapestry, exit past the white horizontal-panel door on your right and small black-framed picture on your left, and walk straight between the black and white curved-lines painting on your left and dining table with blue chairs on your right.

Turn right at the end of the dark counter with stools toward the white double closet doors, then turn left onto the tile floor and walk between the dark counter with stools on your left and the stainless stove and microwave and stainless refrigerator on your right, passing through the doorway ahead.

Turn around in the doorway beneath the open ceiling hatch and walk back past the stainless refrigerator on your left toward the dark counter with stools on your right and white double closet doors ahead.

walk_summary: Start between the grey sofa on the left and the dark armchair with wood arms and TV on white stand on the right, and walk forward to the triple glass doors.
Turn around at the triple glass doors, looking past the TV on white stand, floor lamp, and black and white abstract painting above the grey sofa.

Walk across the wood floor past the grey sofa on the right and the TV on white stand, dining table with blue chairs, and white square pillar on the left, then turn right through a doorway toward the bed with grey headboard.
Walk past the foot of the bed with grey headboard and the grey curved chair to the recessed double window.
Turn around to the left, walk back past the bed with grey headboard toward the potted plant in basket by bed doorway, and turn right into the open closet with shelves.
Turn around to exit the open closet with shelves, step out the doorway past the white square pillar, turn right then left to face the tiled doorway with the white vanity and toilet.
Turn left before the tiled doorway, passing the small black-framed picture on the right into the empty white corner, and turn around to face the white horizontal-panel door.

Walk forward past the small black-framed picture and dining table with blue chairs on the left, turning right toward the dark counter with stools, white double closet doors, and grey flat door with red top.

Step onto the light tile floor past the potted plant in basket near double doors, then pivot clockwise in place past the tall dried branches in vase, stainless stove and microwave, stainless refrigerator, dark counter with stools, and white double closet doors.

Walk forward past the tall dried branches in vase and grey flat door with red top on the left and white double closet doors on the right through a doorway to the wooden desk with chair, skyline print, and small grey loveseat.
Turn right past the small grey loveseat and exit the doorway past the grey flat door with red top toward the dark counter with stools.

Walk forward with the dark counter with stools and dining table with blue chairs on the left and the black and white curved-lines painting on the right, then angle right toward the TV on white stand and woven basket by TV stand.
Step through the doorway next to the woven basket by TV stand to face the bed with wooden headboard, hanging woven tapestry, and black round chair by window.
Turn right and walk down the narrow passage past the walk-through shelving unit on the right to the doorway showing the white toilet with wall art.
Backtrack past the walk-through shelving unit and bed with wooden headboard, turning around near the black round chair by window and hanging woven tapestry to face the exit.

Walk out through the doorway past the white horizontal-panel door on the right and small black-framed picture on the left, continuing straight past the black and white curved-lines painting on the left and dining table with blue chairs on the right to the dark counter with stools.

Turn right toward the white double closet doors, then turn left around the end of the dark counter with stools, walking between the counter and the stainless stove and microwave and stainless refrigerator through a doorway to the white washer and dryer and open ceiling hatch.
Turn around in place by the white washer and dryer and stainless refrigerator to face back toward the dark counter with stools and white double closet doors.

source.camera: held at chest height by a person walking
